title: Loadout Viewer
description: Allows you to see the enchants of worn armor and held tools of anyone with a press of a button
body:
Client side mod that lets you inspect other players' armor and held tools' enchantments from a distance with a single keybind. The information is displayed using custom HUD on the left side of the screen

### How to use
- Look at any player and press the keybind (Default: X)
- Voilà 
  
### Compatability
- Minecraft version 1.21 and up
